bioconda.name: seqforge
bioconda.summary: SeqForge: A genomics toolkit for FASTA processing, BLAST orchestration, and motif mining.
bioconda.description:
SeqForge provides utilities to sanitize, split, annotate, and analyze FASTA files; run BLAST+ queries
in parallel; and perform motif mining with export options. Progress reporting is handled by an
in-house progress bar (no tqdm dependency).

commands: python -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('sf_out')/'t.fa'; assert p.exists(); print(p.read_text()); print('OK')"
